title: Lifecycle Architecture for User Activation
summary: We designed and implemented a behaviour-driven lifecycle architecture that adapts in real time to how users move through the platform. Rather than pushing all users through the same journey, the system observes progression across key onboarding milestones and intervenes only when friction appears.
imageAlt: Illustrative field of dots progressively lighting along a path

meta.label: Industry
meta.value: E-commerce · Digital storefronts for small businesses

context: Yep experienced healthy user sign-ups but faced activation challenges.

challenge.lead: A significant portion of new users abandoned the store-creation process, leaving storefronts incomplete and value unrealised.
challenge.body: The core issue: onboarding was treated as a linear flow, but user behaviour was not.

objectives: Respond to user behaviour rather than assumptions

principles.title: Visibility before optimisation
principles.text: Full tracking of user progression and the points where users stall.

principles.title: Context over volume
principles.text: Interventions aligned with the state a user is actually in.

principles.title: Single next action
principles.text: Each touchpoint guided toward one meaningful step.

approach.title: Behavioural tracking
approach.text: Tracking at the critical onboarding milestones.

approach.title: Automated lifecycle triggers
approach.text: Lifecycle messages triggered by how users progress.

approach.title: Contextual nudges
approach.text: Nudges designed to reduce cognitive load.

built: A behaviour-driven lifecycle architecture that adapts in real time — replacing a linear onboarding flow.
quote: Growth doesn’t break because teams stop trying. It breaks because systems aren’t designed to adapt.

result.headline: Predictable, measurable, repeatable activation.
result.note: USFL has not published figures for these outcomes, so the results are shown as reported, without numbers.

takeaways: Onboarding is a behaviour system, not a linear flow.
Design for one meaningful next step.
